items.description: This chapter covers topics related to building custom visuals and other ways to develop with Power BI. You can also check visuals developed by Akvelon and by Microsoft, which are open-source and serve as good samples of how to implement a custom visual.
items.title: Development

items.description: Power BI utils are set of tools that allow developer of Power BI visual to easily implement most common capabilities of visualizations.

items.title: SVGUtils
items.description: (npm) — simplifies SVG manipulations;

items.title: InteractivityUtils
items.description: (npm) — helps to implement cross-selection and cross-filtering;

items.title: FormattingUtils
items.description: (npm) — provides functionality to format values;

items.title: DataViewUtils
items.description: (npm) — provides set of tools to parse DataView object;

items.title: ChartUtils
items.description: (npm) — helps to create chart axes and drawing labels;

items.title: ColorUtils
items.description: (npm) — manages color manipulations;

items.title: TooltipUtils
items.description: (npm) — simplifies usage of the Tooltip API;

items.title: TestUtils
items.description: (npm) — provides set of mocks and fakes in order to simplify creating unit tests for custom visuals.

items.title: TypeUtils
items.description: (npm) — extends the basic types of Power BI custom visuals;

items.title: Utils
Power BI Javascript
items.description: JavaScript library for embedding Power BI into your apps.

items.title: Power BI C#
items.description: .NET developer community for Power BI.
Akvelon developers are actively supporting and have contributed to the large list of custom open-source, MIT-licensed visuals and tools, started by Microsoft:

items.title: Visuals Tools
items.description: Tools for building/packaging Power BI visuals. Every Power BI custom visuals developer uses these tools.

items.title: Gantt Chart
items.description: A Gantt chart is a type of bar chart which illustrates a project timeline or schedule.

items.title: Sample Bar Chart
items.description: A sample bar chart visual, used for tutorial purposes.

items.title: Chiclet Slicer
items.description: Use this slicer to display image and/or text buttons that act as an in-canvas filter. Define additional properties for the layout & selection to customize this slicer to meet your specific needs.

items.title: Sankey
items.description: Type of flow diagram in which the width of the series is in proportion to the quantity of the flow. Use it to find major contributions to an overall flow.

items.title: Force Graph
items.description: Allows to visualize the relationship between items, the weightage of the relationship and the flow often brings out the untold insights into limelight, which are otherwise not very evident.

items.title: Timeline
items.description: Graphical date range selector used as a filtering component in the report canvas.

items.title: Word Cloud
items.description: Word Cloud is a visual representation of word frequency and value. Use it to get instant insight into the most important terms in a set.

items.title: Tornado
items.description: A bar chart with category values listed vertically. Use for comparing the relative importance of a variable between two distinct groups.

items.title: Sunburst
items.description: Sunburst is a multilevel donut chart, used to visualize hierarchical data, depicted by concentric circles.

items.title: Webpack plugin
items.description: The plugin allows for developing custom visuals by using webpack to build a visual package.

items.title: Sample Slicer
items.description: A sample slicer visual for tutorials, demonstrating the use of the Advanced Filtering API introduced in the version 1.7 of PowerBI Visuals Tools.

items.title: Radar
items.description: A simple radar chart supporting multiple measures plotted over a categorical axis. Also known as a web chart, spider chart, or star chart. Use to display performance metrics for quality improvement.

items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Use this custom visual to build a table heat map that can be used to visualise and compare data values in an easy and intuitive way.

items.title: Chord Diagram
items.description: A chord diagram is a graphical method of displaying the interrelationships between data in a matrix.

items.title: Choropleth
items.description: Displays a hierarchical map set with each location filled in a color from specified values.

items.title: Histogram
items.description: A histogram chart plots data ranges into intervals. Useful for estimating density.

items.title: Mekko Chart
items.description: A mix of a 100% stacked column chart and a 100% stacked bar chart combined into one view. Similar to a treemap, the dimensional values are represented by length and width of each rectangle. The width of a column is proportional to the total value of the column.

items.title: Pulse Chart
items.description: Pulse chart shows a line chart annotated with key events. Each event can be selected to filter and cross highlight other visuals to reveal insights or help tell a story.

items.title: Bullet Chart
items.description: A bullet chart that includes four orientations and a few customization options. Use to feature a single measure against a qualitative range.

items.title: Enhanced Scatter
items.description: A few more properties were added to the existing scatter chart visual, including shapes as markers, background image support, and developer crosshairs for positioning elements onto an image background.

items.title: Dual KPI
items.description: A visual for displaying two correlated KPIs within a single visual.

items.title: Aster
items.description: An Aster plot is a twist on a standard donut chart, using a second value to drive sweep angle.

items.title: Dotplot
items.description: A dot plot is used to show a representation of the distribution of frequencies. It is most often used to show counts of an occurrence.

items.title: Globe Map
items.description: A 3D visual using WebGL for plotting locations, with category values displayed as bar heights and heat maps.

items.title: Stream Graph
items.description: A stacked area chart with smooth interpolation. Often used to display values over time.

items.title: Line Dot Chart
items.description: The LineDot chart is an animated line chart with fun animated dots. Use the LineDot chart to engage your audience especially in a presentation context.

items.title: Funnel
items.description: Find outliers in your data, using a funnel plot.

items.title: Drilldown Player
items.description: Animates report components like a slicer on autopilot.

items.title: Cartogram
items.description: Displays a hierarchical map set as a circle for each location, with size/color from specified values.
